summary: Removes the first node of a singly linked list whose name string (node+0x4) equals a2, comparing with sub_588410. Head lives at this+0x104; each node stores name at +0x4, data at +0xC and next at +0x10. On match the node is unlinked (predecessor's next or the head is re-pointed to the matched node's next), its data is processed via ThunkToFUN0053cb90 and cleared, then name and node are freed. Returns 1 on successful removal, 0 when the list is empty or no node matches. Callers are profile-icon BMP loaders, so the list is a per-owner surface/node registry keyed by name.

local_names.this: owner object holding the surface/node linked list (head at this+0x104)
local_names.a2: name string key to match against node names
local_names.v6: node name pointer, defaulted to byte_5EA438 when null
local_names.v7: node data pointer used in the (dead) cleanup path

operations.description: If the head at this+0x104 is null, return 0 immediately (empty list).
Traverse from the head at this+0x104, tracking the previous node; the current node pointer is held at this+0x114.
Compare the current node's name at node+0x4 against a2 with sub_588410; an equal result ends the traversal at a match, and running out of nodes returns 0.
Name defaulting: when the node name pointer at node+0x4 is null, substitute the byte_5EA438 string before comparison.
Unlink the matched node: the previous node's next (node+0x10), or the head at this+0x104 when there is no previous node, is re-pointed to the matched node's next (node+0x10).
Process the node data at node+0xC through ThunkToFUN0053cb90, then clear the data field to 0.
Dead-path cleanup: if the data field at node+0xC is non-null (it was just cleared, so unreachable in straight-line flow) call sub_542E50, then EmptyStub_7470 and FreeWrapper_7bcf on the data pointer.
If the node name at node+0x4 is non-null, free it with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the node itself with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Return 1 on successful removal; 0 when the list is empty or the key is not found.
Invoked by ProfileIconBmpLoader (004692b0) and CopyProfileIconBMP (0046cd20) to remove a named surface/node from the registry.
